messages.content_text:
apr 23 Notes:


Today I took two trades and they were both losers, and they were honestly both pretty bad trades, but I took them because I am trying to up my trade frequency.
,
Market opened and We had a lot of stacked lows, but I was thinking that we would go to all time highs anyways. I waited until 10:00 and at that point we made even more stacked lows, but I didn’t think we would take them so I took a 5min rb that formed with 10:00, but we wnt straight into consolidation. The thing with this trade is that if I entered off of ce then I could have put my stop at the low and taken a win, so the lesson learned is always cover the low because the rejection block held. It was a bearish candle that got confirmed by the next bullish one. That is unfortunate that it could have been a winner. (Screenshot 1)
,
This next trade was a little less intelligent because once we started to consolidate I thought we might get an amd model. So I waited for one side to get taken and when the top got taken we entered a 5min fvg and formed a 5min rb so I entered and got stopped out instantly. I should have been a little more patient here because we didn’t really trade out of the range, but my conviction was the stacked equal lows. (Screenshot 2)
,
There were three other trades I could have taken today, the first was limiting the ce and covering the low. That is 100% a lesson learned and won’t make that mistake again. The second was a 1min powell model. The 10:00 manipuation move had a 1min rb at the bottom  and formed el above the ce. This trade would have been a minimal drawdown entry and very good rr. (Screenshot 3)
,

He who has a why, can bear almost any how.

I started watching my first trading videos in December 2025. By the summer, I had graduated and began applying for engineering jobs, but I couldn’t land a single one. Everywhere I went, I heard the same thing: “You don’t have any experience.”

That’s when it really hit me, five years of my life spent on something I don’t even enjoy.

Right now, I’m working a job I hate, but I need it to have some income.

Four months later, I’ve blown two accounts due to revenge trading and using way too much leverage. Hence why I’m now committing to the following rules:


Two trades a day, if it’s a W close laptop, if its a L I can risk again with less risk (75 first trade 50 second trade). Second lose, close laptop and tape read pa after the gym. If its BE you can look for re entry if DOL is still intact. BE is also a trade.
,


Risk 12.5% of max drawdown per trade, as I’m not super confident in myself, I want to give myself 8 trades before blowing.
,


Journal all trades in this channel, even non trading days.
,


Journal your emotions everyday, also after the trades.
,


Chase this dream like there is no tomorrow nigga.
,
